blocks.text: I am doing va I do: farqi nimada?

3–7-darslarda ikki zamonni alohida o'rgandik. Endi ularni yonma-yon qo'yamiz. Xushxabar: o'zbek tilida ham xuddi shunday farq bor! «Dadam hozir ovqat pishir**yapti**» — Present Continuous: **is cooking**. «Dadam yakshanba kunlari ovqat pishir**adi**» — Present Simple: **cooks**. Agar o'zbekchada `-yapti` desangiz, inglizchada odatda **am / is / are + -ing**; agar `-adi` / `-ydi` (odatda, doim) desangiz — Present Simple.

rows: hozir, ayni paytda; shu kunlarda, vaqtincha
odatda, doim, takroriy; doimiy holat; fakt
now, right now, at the moment, today, this week, Look! Listen!
usually, always, often, never, every day, on Mondays

items.text: Mum **is sleeping** now. She **works** at night.
Dilnoza **speaks** four languages. Right now she**'s speaking** Korean.
We usually **eat** at home, but today we**'re eating** out.

blocks.text: Present Continuous faqat «shu soniya» emas, balki **vaqtinchalik davr** uchun ham ishlatiladi: this week, this month, this year, at the moment. Present Simple esa **doimiy**, uzoq muddatli holatni bildiradi. Taqqoslang: Bekzod **lives** in Tashkent (u yerda doimiy yashaydi), but this month he**'s living** in London (bir oyga, vaqtincha). Ma'nosi: hozirgi holat tez orada o'zgaradi.

items.text: My father **works** in a bank, but this week he**'s working** from home.
items.translation: Dadam bankda **ishlaydi**, lekin bu hafta uydan turib **ishlayapti**.

items.text: Emma **is staying** with friends until she finds a flat.

blocks.text: Ba'zi fe'llar **harakat** emas, **holat**ni bildiradi: bilmoq, yoqtirmoq, xohlamoq, ega bo'lmoq. Holatning «jarayoni» yo'q — u boshlanib, davom etib, tugab turmaydi, shunchaki **bor**. Shuning uchun bunday fe'llar hatto «hozir» ma'nosida ham odatda **Present Simple**'da turadi: I **know** («I'm knowing» emas), I **want** a drink («I'm wanting» emas). O'zbekchada esa ba'zan `-yapti` ishlatamiz («tushunyapman», «xohlayapman»), shu sababli o'zbeklar bu yerda ko'p xato qiladi.

rows: She **wants** a coffee. — U qahva xohlayapti.
This bag **belongs** to me. — Bu sumka meniki.
I **hear** a strange noise. — G'alati ovoz eshityapman.
It **costs** ten pounds. — Bu o'n funt turadi.

items.text: Wait a minute — **I need** my glasses.

blocks.text: have va think: ikki xil ma'no

Ba'zi fe'llar bir ma'nosida holat (Simple), boshqa ma'nosida harakat (Continuous) bo'ladi. **have** «ega bo'lmoq» ma'nosida — holat: She **has** a car. Lekin **have breakfast / lunch / a shower / a good time / a party** — harakat, shuning uchun Continuous bo'la oladi: She**'s having** breakfast. **think** «fikri bor, deb hisoblamoq» ma'nosida — holat: I **think** it's a good idea. «O'ylamoq, mulohaza qilmoq» ma'nosida — harakat: I**'m thinking** about my exam.

rows: We**'re having** dinner. — Kechki ovqat qilyapmiz.
I**'m thinking** about you. — Sizni o'ylayapman.
He**'s tasting** the soup. — U sho'rvani tatib ko'ryapti.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I'm knowing him.» → **I know him.**; «I'm not understanding.» → **I don't understand.**; «Are you wanting tea?» → **Do you want tea?**; «She is having a car.» → **She has a car.**; «Every day I'm going to work by bus.» → **Every day I go to work by bus.**; «Look! It rains.» → **Look! It's raining.**; «What do you do now?» (hozir nima qilyapsan?) → **What are you doing now?**

Sinab ko'ring: fe'lni «...ish jarayonida» deb ayta olasizmi? «Ishlash jarayonidaman», «ovqat qilish jarayonidaman» — bo'ladi, demak Continuous mumkin. «Bilish jarayonidaman», «yoqtirish jarayonidaman» — g'alati, demak bu holat fe'li: faqat Simple. Shubha bo'lsa: know, like, want, need — hech qachon -ing bilan emas.
What are you doing? / What do you do?

Savollarda ham farq bir xil: **What are you doing?** — «Hozir nima qilyapsan?», javob: I'm cooking. **What do you do?** — «Kasbingiz nima? Nima ish qilasiz?», javob: I'm a doctor / I work in a bank. **Are you working?** — hozir yoki shu kunlarda; **Do you work?** — umuman ishlaysizmi.

Bog'lanish: Present Continuous — 3–4-darslar; Present Simple — 5–7-darslar; Present Continuous kelajak rejasi uchun (I**'m flying** to London on Friday) — 25-dars; o'tgan zamonda xuddi shu farq (I **was doing** / I **did**) — 14-dars; chastota so'zlarining o'rni — 94-dars.

rows: I**'m reading** a great book this week.

examples.title: Now or usually? **is cooking** / **cooks**
examples.description: Present Continuous — hozir, ayni paytda (now, today, Look!); Present Simple — odatda, takroriy (usually, every day, on Sundays). O'zbekchada ham shunday farq bor: pishir**yapti** / pishir**adi**.

sentences.text: Dad usually **cooks** on Sundays, but today Mum **is cooking**.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari odatda dadam ovqat **pishiradi**, lekin bugun oyim **pishiryapti**.

sentences.text: I**'m drinking** coffee now, but I usually **drink** tea.
sentences.translation: Hozir qahva **ichyapman**, lekin odatda choy **ichaman**.

sentences.text: Look, it**'s snowing**! It rarely **snows** here in March.
sentences.translation: Qara, qor **yog'yapti**! Bu yerda martda kamdan-kam qor **yog'adi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **plays** the piano very well. Listen — he**'s playing** now.
sentences.translation: Bekzod pianinoni juda yaxshi **chaladi**. Eshit — hozir **chalyapti**.

sentences.text: The children **are watching** TV, but they usually **read** in the evening.
sentences.translation: Bolalar televizor **ko'rishyapti**, lekin kechqurunlari odatda kitob **o'qishadi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **walks** to work every day. Today she**'s taking** a taxi because it's raining.
sentences.translation: Sara har kuni ishga piyoda **boradi**. Bugun yomg'ir yog'ayotgani uchun taksida **ketyapti**.

sentences.text: Why **are** you **wearing** a suit? You never **wear** one!
sentences.translation: Nega kostyum **kiyib olding**? Sen hech qachon kostyum **kiymaysan**-ku!

sentences.text: At the moment Madina **is talking** to a customer — she **talks** to fifty people a day.
sentences.translation: Hozir Madina mijoz bilan **gaplashyapti** — u kuniga ellik kishi bilan **gaplashadi**.

sentences.text: Our train usually **leaves** on time, but today it **isn't moving**.
sentences.translation: Poyezdimiz odatda o'z vaqtida **jo'naydi**, lekin bugun **qimirlamayapti**.

sentences.text: Every morning Aziz **goes** to the gym, but this morning he**'s sleeping**.
sentences.translation: Aziz har tongda sport zaliga **boradi**, lekin bugun ertalab **uxlayapti**.

examples.title: Temporary or permanent? **is living** / **lives**
examples.description: Present Continuous — vaqtincha holat (this week, this year, at the moment); Present Simple — doimiy holat. He **lives** in Oxford, but this month he**'s working** in Tashkent.

sentences.text: James **lives** in Oxford, but this month he**'s working** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Oksfordda **yashaydi**, lekin bu oy Toshkentda **ishlayapti**.

sentences.text: I**'m staying** with my aunt until I find a flat.
sentences.translation: Kvartira topgunimcha xolamnikida **turibman**.

sentences.text: My brother usually **works** in an office, but this week he**'s working** from home.
sentences.translation: Akam odatda ofisda **ishlaydi**, lekin bu hafta uydan turib **ishlayapti**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **teaches** English. This year she**'s also learning** Korean.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ingliz tilidan **dars beradi**. Bu yil u koreys tilini ham **o'rganyapti**.

sentences.text: We**'re renting** a flat at the moment; we **don't own** a house.
sentences.translation: Hozir kvartirani **ijaraga olib turibmiz**, o'z uyimiz **yo'q**.

sentences.text: The bridge is closed, so the buses **are going** a different way this week.
sentences.translation: Ko'prik yopiq, shuning uchun bu hafta avtobuslar boshqa yo'ldan **yuryapti**.

sentences.text: Normally the bus **goes** over the bridge.
sentences.translation: Odatda avtobus ko'prik ustidan **o'tadi**.

sentences.text: These days more people **are working** from home, but most people still **work** in offices.
sentences.translation: Shu kunlarda ko'proq odam uydan **ishlayapti**, lekin ko'pchilik hali ham ofislarda **ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: Madina usually **lives** with her parents, but at the moment she**'s living** in a student flat in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Madina odatda ota-onasi bilan **yashaydi**, lekin hozir Samarqanddagi talabalar kvartirasida **yashayapti**.

sentences.text: Grandpa **is staying** in hospital this week, so we **visit** him every evening.
sentences.translation: Bobom bu hafta shifoxonada **yotibdi**, shuning uchun har kuni kechqurun uning oldiga **boramiz**.

examples.title: State verbs: **know**, **understand**, **remember**
examples.description: Fikr va bilim fe'llari — holat, jarayon emas, shuning uchun «hozir» ma'nosida ham Present Simple'da turadi: I **know** («I'm knowing» emas), I **don't understand**, Do you **remember**?

sentences.text: **I know** that man, but **I don't remember** his name.
sentences.translation: U odamni **taniyman**, lekin ismini **eslay olmayapman**.

sentences.text: Sorry, **I don't understand** this question.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu savolni **tushunmayapman**.

sentences.text: **Do** you **remember** our first teacher, Mrs Smith?
sentences.translation: Birinchi o'qituvchimiz Smit xonimni **eslaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Aziz **believes** everything he reads on the internet.
sentences.translation: Aziz internetda o'qigan hamma narsasiga **ishonadi**.

sentences.text: Now **I understand** — you **mean** the other Madina!
sentences.translation: Endi **tushundim** — siz boshqa Madinani **nazarda tutyapsiz**!

sentences.text: Excuse me, **do** you **know** a good café near here?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, shu yaqinda yaxshi kafe **bilasizmi**?

sentences.text: My grandmother **forgets** names, but she **remembers** every song from her childhood.
sentences.translation: Buvim ismlarni **unutadi**, lekin bolaligidagi har bir qo'shiqni **eslaydi**.

sentences.text: What **does** this word **mean**? I **don't recognise** it.
sentences.translation: Bu so'z nimani **anglatadi**? Uni **tanimayapman**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **doesn't believe** in luck — he **believes** in hard work.
sentences.translation: Bekzod omadga **ishonmaydi** — u mehnatga **ishonadi**.

sentences.text: Everybody **knows** the answer, but nobody **understands** why it's correct.
sentences.translation: Javobni hamma **biladi**, lekin nega to'g'ri ekanini hech kim **tushunmaydi**.

examples.title: State verbs: **like**, **love**, **want**, **need**, **prefer**
examples.description: His-tuyg'u va istak fe'llari ham odatda Continuous'da ishlatilmaydi: I **want** a drink now («I'm wanting» emas), She **needs** help, I **prefer** tea. **enjoy** va **feel** esa Continuous bo'la oladi.

sentences.text: **I want** a glass of cold water, please.
sentences.translation: Bir stakan sovuq suv **xohlayman**, iltimos.

sentences.text: Madina **loves** her new job at the museum.
sentences.translation: Madina muzeydagi yangi ishini juda **yaxshi ko'radi**.

sentences.text: We **need** more chairs — the guests **are arriving**!
sentences.translation: Yana stullar **kerak** — mehmonlar **kelishyapti**!

sentences.text: **Do** you **like** this colour, or **do** you **prefer** the blue one?
sentences.translation: Sizga bu rang **yoqadimi** yoki ko'kini **afzal ko'rasizmi**?

sentences.text: Tom **hates** waiting, and the queue **is getting** longer.
sentences.translation: Tom kutishni **yomon ko'radi**, navbat esa tobora **uzunlashyapti**.

sentences.text: My little son **wants** a dog, but my wife **doesn't like** animals at home.
sentences.translation: Kichkina o'g'lim it **xohlaydi**, lekin xotinim uyda hayvon boqishni **yoqtirmaydi**.

sentences.text: Right now **I need** your help — **are** you **doing** anything?
sentences.translation: Hozir yordamingiz **kerak** — biror ish **qilyapsizmi**?

sentences.text: Sarah **prefers** the bus because she **doesn't like** driving in the city.
sentences.translation: Sara avtobusni **afzal ko'radi**, chunki shaharda mashina haydashni **yoqtirmaydi**.

sentences.text: The children **are enjoying** the film — they **love** cartoons.
sentences.translation: Bolalar filmdan **zavqlanyapti** — ular multfilmlarni **juda yaxshi ko'rishadi**.

sentences.text: Honestly, **I don't want** to go out tonight; I**'m feeling** a bit tired.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, bugun kechqurun ko'chaga chiqqim **kelmayapti**; o'zimni biroz charchagan **his qilyapman**.

examples.title: **have** / **is having**, **think** / **is thinking**
examples.description: Ikki ma'noli fe'llar. **have** = ega bo'lmoq (Simple) / ovqatlanmoq, cho'milmoq, dam olmoq (Continuous). **think** = fikri bor (Simple) / o'ylamoq jarayoni (Continuous).

sentences.text: Aziz **has** a big family — he **has** four sisters.
sentences.translation: Azizning oilasi katta — to'rtta opa-singlisi **bor**.

sentences.text: Aziz isn't free right now — he**'s having** lunch.
sentences.translation: Aziz hozir band — **tushlik qilyapti**.

sentences.text: **I think** your plan is very good.
sentences.translation: **Menimcha**, rejangiz juda yaxshi.

sentences.text: What **are** you **thinking** about? You look sad.
sentences.translation: Nima haqida **o'ylayapsan**? Xafa ko'rinasan.

sentences.text: We **don't have** a dishwasher, so I wash the plates by hand.
sentences.translation: Bizda idish yuvadigan mashina **yo'q**, shuning uchun likopchalarni qo'lda yuvaman.

sentences.text: Shh! The baby **is having** a bath.
sentences.translation: Jim! Chaqaloq **cho'milyapti**.

sentences.text: Emma **thinks** the hotel is too expensive.
sentences.translation: Emmaning **fikricha**, mehmonxona juda qimmat.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **is thinking** of moving to London, but her parents **don't think** it's a good idea.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Londonga ko'chib o'tishni **o'ylayapti**, lekin ota-onasi buni yaxshi fikr deb **hisoblamaydi**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **having** a good time? — Yes, the party is great!
sentences.translation: Yaxshi **dam olyapsanmi**? — Ha, bazm zo'r!

sentences.text: My parents **have** a house by the sea, and this week they**'re having** a holiday there.
sentences.translation: Ota-onamning dengiz bo'yida uyi **bor**, bu hafta ular o'sha yerda **dam olishyapti**.

examples.title: **What are you doing?** / **What do you do?**
examples.description: Savollarda ham farq bor: **What are you doing?** — «Hozir nima qilyapsan?», **What do you do?** — «Kasbingiz nima?». **Do** you ...? — odat; **Are** you ...-ing? — hozir.

sentences.text: **What are** you **doing**? — I'm looking for my keys.
sentences.translation: Nima **qilyapsan**? — Kalitlarimni qidiryapman.

sentences.text: **What do** you **do**? — I'm a pharmacist.
sentences.translation: **Kasbingiz nima**? — Farmatsevtman.

sentences.text: **Are** you **working** today? — No, it's my day off.
sentences.translation: Bugun **ishlayapsizmi**? — Yo'q, bugun dam olish kunim.

sentences.text: **Do** you **work** at weekends? — Only on Saturdays.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari **ishlaysizmi**? — Faqat shanba kunlari.

sentences.text: Bekzod, why **are** you **running**? — I'm late for the bus!
sentences.translation: Bekzod, nega **yuguryapsan**? — Avtobusga kechikyapman!

sentences.text: **Does** your sister **cook**? — Yes, she does. Actually, she**'s cooking** now.
sentences.translation: Opang ovqat **pishiradimi**? — Ha. Aslida, hozir **pishiryapti**.

sentences.text: **Is** it **raining**? — Yes, it is. It often **rains** here in November.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **yog'yaptimi**? — Ha. Bu yerda noyabrda tez-tez yomg'ir **yog'adi**.

sentences.text: Madina, where **are** you **going**? — To the market, like every Saturday.
sentences.translation: Madina, qayerga **ketyapsan**? — Bozorga, har shanbadagidek.

sentences.text: What **does** your brother **do** in the evenings? And what **is** he **doing** right now?
sentences.translation: Akang kechqurunlari **nima qiladi**? Hozir-chi, **nima qilyapti**?

sentences.text: So, how **do** you usually **spend** your weekends, and what **are** you **reading** at the moment?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, dam olish kunlarini odatda **qanday o'tkazasiz** va hozir **nima o'qiyapsiz**?

examples.title: **see**, **hear**, **taste**, **cost**, **belong**
examples.description: Sezgi (see, hear, smell, taste) va boshqa holat fe'llari (cost, belong, seem, contain, depend) ham odatda Present Simple'da: This soup **tastes** great. The bag **belongs** to me.

sentences.text: **I hear** music — the neighbours **are having** a party.
sentences.translation: Musiqa **eshityapman** — qo'shnilar bazm **qilishyapti**.

sentences.text: This soup **tastes** wonderful! What's in it?
sentences.translation: Bu sho'rva juda **mazali**! Ichida nima bor?

sentences.text: How much **does** this jacket **cost**?
sentences.translation: Bu kurtka qancha **turadi**?

sentences.text: Something **smells** good — **are** you **baking** bread?
sentences.translation: Nimadir yoqimli **hid taratyapti** — non **yopyapsanmi**?

sentences.text: That red car **belongs** to our neighbour, Mr Rashidov.
sentences.translation: Anavi qizil mashina qo'shnimiz Rashidov **akaniki**.

sentences.text: **Do** you **see** that tall building? That's my office.
sentences.translation: Anavi baland binoni **ko'ryapsizmi**? O'sha mening ofisim.

sentences.text: Bekzod **seems** tired today — he **isn't saying** much.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bugun charchagan **ko'rinadi** — ko'p **gapirmayapti**.

sentences.text: Emma **is tasting** the sauce to check the salt.
sentences.translation: Emma tuzini bilish uchun sousni **tatib ko'ryapti**.

sentences.text: The box **contains** old photos of my grandparents.
sentences.translation: Qutida bobom va buvimning eski suratlari **bor**.

sentences.text: Our trip **depends** on the weather, and right now it**'s raining** heavily.
sentences.translation: Sayohatimiz ob-havoga **bog'liq**, hozir esa kuchli yomg'ir **yog'yapti**.

examples.title: Mixed: a postcard from Samarkand
examples.description: Mustahkamlash: Present Continuous (hozir, shu kunlarda) va Present Simple (odatda, doim, holat fe'llari) bitta xatda.

sentences.text: Dear Emma, **I'm writing** this card in a café in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Aziz Emma, bu otkritkani Samarqanddagi bir kafeda **yozyapman**.

sentences.text: We**'re staying** in a small hotel near the Registan.
sentences.translation: Registon yaqinidagi kichkina mehmonxonada **turibmiz**.

sentences.text: The hotel **has** a lovely garden, and the owners are very kind.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaning chiroyli bog'i **bor**, egalari ham juda mehribon.

sentences.text: Every morning we **have** breakfast on the roof.
sentences.translation: Har tongda tomda **nonushta qilamiz**.

sentences.text: Right now Aziz **is taking** photos of the old buildings.
sentences.translation: Hozir Aziz eski binolarni **suratga olyapti**.

sentences.text: He **takes** hundreds of photos every day!
sentences.translation: U har kuni yuzlab surat **oladi**!

sentences.text: **I love** this city — the people are so friendly.
sentences.translation: Bu shaharni **juda yaxshi ko'raman** — odamlari juda samimiy.

sentences.text: It's very hot, so we usually **rest** in the afternoon.
sentences.translation: Havo juda issiq, shuning uchun tushdan keyin odatda **dam olamiz**.

sentences.text: **I don't understand** much Uzbek, but **I'm learning** a few words every day.
sentences.translation: O'zbekchani ko'p **tushunmayman**, lekin har kuni bir nechta so'z **o'rganyapman**.

sentences.text: **I miss** you all, and **I hope** you**'re enjoying** the summer in London! Love, Sarah
sentences.translation: Hammangizni **sog'indim**. Umid qilamanki, Londonda yozdan **zavqlanyapsizlar**! Mehr bilan, Sara
